notes.title: Feature-Requests Added
notes.content:
By popular request we have added new features to [b]Barnyard Mahjong 3[/b].

[u]Feature Summary[/u]
[list]
[*] The ability to reset scores and stars in all of the levels
[*] The ability to toggle sound, music and game timer on / off
[*] An additional tutorial slide in level 1-1
[/list]

Sincerely,
EnsenaSoft
